
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19194651" title="发布于 2025-11-05 21:34">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ASP.NET Core Blazor 核心功能三：Blazor与JavaScript互操作——让Web开发更灵活</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p id="CJmjN"><span id="cke_bm_5937S">嗨，大家好！我是码农刚子。今天我们来聊聊Blazor中C#与JavaScript互操作。我知道很多同学在听到"Blazor"和"JavaScript"要一起工作时会有点懵，但别担心，我会用最简单的方式带你掌握这个技能！</span></p>
<h2 id="IKuoM">为什么要学JavaScript互操作？</h2>
<p id="u0a7317bb">想象一下：你正在用Blazor开发一个超棒的应用，但突然需要用到某个只有JavaScript才能实现的炫酷效果，或者要集成一个超好用的第三方JS库。这时候，JavaScript互操作就是你的救星！</p>
<p id="u8a2985f1">简单来说，它让Blazor和JavaScript可以"握手合作"，各展所长。下面我们就从最基础的部分开始。</p>
<h2 id="jjP7E">1. IJSRuntime - 你的JavaScript通行证</h2>
<p id="u973470ad">在Blazor中，<code>IJSRuntime</code>是与JavaScript沟通的桥梁。获取它超级简单：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="16" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@inject IJSRuntime JSRuntime

</span>&lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ShowAlert</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;点我弹窗！&lt;/button&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task ShowAlert()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">alert</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello from Blazor!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202511/1466017-20251105212925789-2048555158.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
</div>
<p id="ua0dcb324">就两行关键代码：</p>
<ul>
<li id="u5f551bd8"><code>@inject IJSRuntime JSRuntime</code> - 拿到通行证</li>
<li id="u0c286a2b"><code>InvokeVoidAsync</code> - 调用不返回值的JS函数</li>
</ul>
<p id="u99ce1d6f"><strong>实际场景</strong>：比如用户完成某个操作后，你想显示一个提示，用这种方式就特别方便。</p>
<h2 id="y6euZ">2. 调用JavaScript函数 - 不只是简单弹窗</h2>
<p id="u5e86e359">当然，我们不会只满足于弹窗。来看看更实用的例子：</p>
<p id="u2a48d869">首先，在<code>wwwroot/index.html</code>中添加我们的JavaScript工具函数：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="14" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<div class="cnblogs_code">

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建命名空间避免全局污染</span>
    window.myJsHelpers =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        showNotification: function (message, type) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟显示一个漂亮的提示框</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> notification = document.createElement(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

                transition: all </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.3s ease;
            `;
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (type === <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">success</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                notification.style.backgroundColor </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#28a745</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (type === <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                notification.style.backgroundColor </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#dc3545</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                notification.style.backgroundColor </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#17a2b8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
            
            notification.textContent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> message;
            document.body.appendChild(notification);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3秒后自动消失</span>
            setTimeout(() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                notification.remove();
            }, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        },
        
        getBrowserInfo: function () {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
                language: navigator.language,
                platform: navigator.platform
            };
        },
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 带参数的计算函数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        calculateDiscount: function (originalPrice, discountPercent) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> originalPrice * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> - discountPercent / <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }

<blockquote>
<p id="ubcba5fe0"><strong>Note</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li id="ua0c09891">使用<code>InvokeVoidAsync</code>调用不返回值的函数</li>
<li id="uc4ccea80">使用<code>InvokeAsync&lt;T&gt;</code>调用有返回值的函数，记得指定返回类型</li>
<li id="u85250f0d">复杂对象会自动序列化/反序列化</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="Y1O76">3. 把.NET方法暴露给JavaScript - 双向操作</h2>
<p id="u02d99384">有时候，我们也需要让JavaScript能调用我们的C#方法。这就用到<code>[JSInvokable]</code>特性了。</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="10" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@inject IJSRuntime JSRuntime
@implements IDisposable

</span>&lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">demo-container</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;.NET方法暴露演示&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mb-3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;消息内容:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;input @bind=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-control</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    
    &lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mb-3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;重复次数:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;input type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">number</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> @bind=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">repeatCount</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-control</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    
    &lt;button @onclick=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">RegisterDotNetMethods</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">btn btn-primary</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        注册.NET方法给JavaScript使用
    </span>&lt;/button&gt;
    
    &lt;div id=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js-output</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mt-3 p-3 border rounded</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
        &lt;!-- JavaScript会在这里输出内容 --&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@code {

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在index.html中添加</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">function registerDotNetHelper(dotNetHelper) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 存储.NET引用供后续使用</span>
    window.dotNetHelper =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dotNetHelper;
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 演示调用.NET方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    callDotNetMethods();
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> function callDotNetMethods() {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">window.dotNetHelper) {
        console.error(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.NET helper 未注册</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用无参数的.NET方法</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> message = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> window.dotNetHelper.invokeMethodAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GetFormattedMessage</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用带参数的异步.NET方法</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> processed = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> window.dotNetHelper.invokeMethodAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ProcessDataAsync</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello world</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用void方法</span>
        window.dotNetHelper.invokeMethodAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ShowAlert</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">这是从JS发来的消息！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在页面上显示结果</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> output = document.getElementById(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js-output</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {

<blockquote>
<p id="uf43f3ae3"><strong>Note</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li id="u78c5136e">记得使用<code>DotNetObjectReference</code>来创建引用</li>
<li id="ud1e63383">使用<code>Dispose()</code>及时清理资源</li>
<li id="u06c4a3e8">异步方法要返回<code>Task</code>或<code>Task&lt;T&gt;</code></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="tKMmo">4. 使用JavaScript库 - 集成第三方神器</h2>
<p id="u5c46a847">这是最实用的部分！让我们看看如何集成流行的JavaScript库。</p>

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">chartHelpers.updateChart</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
            chartInstance, newData);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task SwitchToProfitChart()
    {
        isSalesData </span>= !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">isSalesData;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> newData = isSalesData ? 
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {

                datasets </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {

                    }
                }
            } :
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                labels </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Q1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Q2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Q3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Q4</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
                datasets </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {

        {

<h2 id="CBNuY">常见问题与解决方案</h2>
<h3 id="IwpBr">问题1：JS互操作调用失败</h3>
<p id="u2f1fc15d"><strong>症状</strong>：控制台报错，函数未定义</p>
<p id="ucf60d456"><strong>解决</strong>：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">someFunction</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (JSException ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">JS调用失败: {ex.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 回退方案</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">console.warn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">功能不可用</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3 id="Bbu8K">问题2：性能优化</h3>
<p id="u9ba0e2e4">对于频繁调用的JS函数，可以使用<code>IJSInProcessRuntime</code>：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@inject IJSRuntime JSRuntime

@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IJSInProcessRuntime jsInProcess;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnInitialized()
    {
        jsInProcess </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (IJSInProcessRuntime)JSRuntime;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HandleInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 同步调用，更高效</span>
        jsInProcess.InvokeVoidAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">handleInput</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e.Value.ToString());
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3 id="S6Hx8">问题3：组件销毁时资源清理</h3>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="0" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@implements IDisposable

@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> DotNetObjectReference&lt;MyComponent&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dotNetRef;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IJSObjectReference jsModule;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        dotNetRef </span>= DotNetObjectReference.Create(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        jsModule </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> JSRuntime.InvokeAsync&lt;IJSObjectReference&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./js/myModule.js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dispose()
    {
        dotNetRef</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Dispose();
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (jsModule != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> jsModule.DisposeAsync();
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p id="u16960393">Blazor的JavaScript互操作其实没那么难的。记住这几个关键点：</p>
<ul>
<li id="u1914569e"><strong>IJSRuntime</strong> 是你的通行证</li>
<li id="u07a69a49"><strong>InvokeVoidAsync</strong> 和 <strong>InvokeAsync</strong> 是主要工具</li>
<li id="u659c2bd6"><strong>[JSInvokable]</strong> 让.NET方法对JS可见</li>
<li id="uc5886027"><strong>及时清理资源</strong> 很重要</li>
</ul>
<p id="u4595f343">现在你已经掌握了Blazor与JavaScript互操作的核心技能！试着在自己的项目中实践一下，示例源码更放在仓库：<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="23" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><a class="cke_widget_editable cke_widget_element" title="https://github.com/shenchuanchao/BlazorApp/tree/master/BlazorAppWasm/Pages" href="https://github.com/shenchuanchao/BlazorApp/tree/master/BlazorAppWasm/Pages" data-cke-enter-mode="2" data-cke-saved-href="https://github.com/shenchuanchao/BlazorApp/tree/master/BlazorAppWasm/Pages" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fshenchuanchao%2FBlazorApp%2Ftree%2Fmaster%2FBlazorAppWasm%2FPages%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fshenchuanchao%2FBlazorApp%2Ftree%2Fmaster%2FBlazorAppWasm%2FPages%22%2C%22desc%22%3A%22%22%2C%22icon%22%3A%22%22%2C%22isCard%22%3Afalse%2C%22hasResquest%22%3Atrue%2C%22iconDefault%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.4%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DP9T8%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22g9eJ3t-1762348839966%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-editable="text" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-link-icon="https://csdnimg.cn/release/blog_editor_html/release2.4.4/ckeditor/plugins/CsdnLink/icons/icon-default.png?t=P9T8" data-link-title="https://github.com/shenchuanchao/BlazorApp/tree/master/BlazorAppWasm/Pages" data-widget="csdnlink" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/shenchuanchao/BlazorApp/tree/master/BlazorAppWasm/Pages</a></span></p>
